conventions.acceleration: A_a = U^b nabla_b U_a; physical units m s^-2
conventions.shear: sigma_ab = projected symmetric tracefree part of nabla_b U_a; units s^-1
conventions.vorticity: omega_ab = projected antisymmetric part; omega_A = (1/2) epsilon_ABC omega^BC; units s^-1
conventions.beta: dimensionless relative three-velocity in named tetrad/frame convention
conventions.sample_semantics: posterior_draw | confidence_witness | null_realization | injection | observed_carrier; do not mix under one axis

state.name: JointAnisotropyState_R39

derived_blocks.rule: first order beta_RO=beta_RM+beta_MO+O(beta^2); exact ordered tetrad composition required beyond first order

state.dimension_note: 17 core independent components at one fixed point/epoch when beta_RM and beta_MO are both present; 18 with scalar DeltaOmega_k. For a single beta only, sigma+omega+A+beta has 14 components. These are coordinate counts, not observational rank.

frame_transport_policy.canonical_velocity_bundle: beta_RO, beta_RM and beta_MO are all stored in one common VelocityFrameBundle.coordinate_frame and basis. radiation_frame_id, matter_frame_id and observer_frame_id describe the physical endpoints/roles of relative motions, not the coordinate frame in which each vector's components are stored.
frame_transport_policy.spatial_basis_transport: An orthogonal 3x3 FrameTransport changes only triad axes within the same component coordinate frame and transforms axial vectors with det(R)R.
frame_transport_policy.relativistic_frame_bridge: A vector arriving from a genuinely different component coordinate frame requires an explicit ordered Lorentz/tetrad bridge into the canonical coordinate frame before mixed contractions. A spatial 3x3 rotation is not such a bridge.
frame_transport_policy.beta_RO: canonical beta_RO and its closure residual/status/remainder are preserved; the first-order beta_RM+beta_MO sum is a separately labelled conditional diagnostic view, not an exact velocity composition and not an independent coordinate.

sigma_coordinate_chart.note: This is not an orthonormal STF basis. Any flattened SVD/covariance must use the induced Gram metric or a declared orthonormal transform.

state.canonical_ssot: exact JointAnisotropyState; R39 KinematicalState is derived physical-SI view only

vorticity_dual_convention.anchor_boundary: The canonical crosswalk W2 anchor is not bound to an R39 vector-norm functional until the canonical omega_axial3 metric/normalization is confirmed.

functionals.interpretation: dimensionless axial-vector norm; not automatically canonical omega_ab omega^ab/(6H^2) MES W2 invariant

observed_carriers.note: Retain reality, polarization parity, frequency/split, mask/beam/window and full covariance.
Not an additional independent dataset when estimated from the same a_lm.
Use the LOOP C common-congruence optical response; radial d contains H/shear/acceleration; transverse drift contains shear/vorticity plus explicit catalogue triad rotation. Local limit only.

required_probe_blocks: local optical radial-rate and angular-drift joint response
likelihood_contract.required_covariance: full within-probe and cross-probe covariance or explicit conditional-independence model; never default missing blocks to zero

local_optical_response.triad_spin: Omega is an explicit axial nuisance; without independent calibration B1 measures omega+Omega
local_optical_response.acceleration_endpoint: common observer/emitter acceleration cancels from the leading angular-drift term; do not append an extra c P A
ideal_full_sphere_inverse: omega=-(3/2)<n cross mu> in calibrated Fermi-Walker triad
limitations: finite catalogue requires its actual selection/window/covariance and source-slip model

htt_five_outputs.x: direct kinematical components + predicted observable carriers + mixed functionals; observed carriers kept fixed and role-tagged
htt_five_outputs.Q: matching anchor/acceptance body and gauge; unavailable anchors remain unavailable
htt_five_outputs.F: directional support, sample pushforward and measure-defined occupancy are distinct
htt_five_outputs.Pi: law-conditional exceedance surface; likelihood/profile likelihood is not a probability law
htt_five_outputs.G_F: full-covariance functional depth path preserving initial level and paired cross-window covariance

local_optical_limit.convention: n points from observer towards source
local_optical_limit.directional_H: H_u(n)=vartheta/3 - A_a n^a/c + sigma_ab n^a n^b
local_optical_limit.response_blindness: omega_ab n^a n^b=0 at this order because omega_ab is antisymmetric
local_optical_limit.warning: local z->0 response is not a finite-redshift light-cone transfer; beta_MO Doppler response is distinct from intrinsic A_a

acceptance: state identity and congruence/frame/epoch/basis metadata are common across each sample's functionals
direct tensor components and mixed functionals preserve rank/parity/units
O(3) improper transformations correctly distinguish polar and axial vectors
observed carriers and predicted carriers are not conflated or double counted
likelihood providers are source/row/selection/covariance/operator bound and fail closed
shared sky/LSS/catalogue/calibration dependencies are modeled jointly
functional local and global identifiability are assessed separately
five HTT outputs are derived from one joint posterior/compatibility object
x_C remains one optional legacy scalar projection
local radial and transverse optical response is jointly tested in the ideal common-congruence limit
catalogue angular B1 is not promoted to physical vorticity without independent triad-spin calibration
finite-survey optical response uses source-level selection, tangent-basis transformation, covariance support and finite-distance remainder
beta_RM and beta_MO mixed functionals are evaluated only after both vectors share one physical tetrad; a spatial rotation is never treated as a Lorentz boost
the sigma five-vector uses canonical STF5 Cartesian coordinate order and its induced Gram metric, not an undocumented orthonormal basis
all beta_RO/RM/MO components retain the common VelocityFrameBundle coordinate_frame/basis and distinct endpoint frame IDs
a spatial FrameTransport is not used as a Lorentz transformation

implementation.source_identity: canonical JointAnisotropyState.content_id shared by both normalized canonical results and physical-SI functional views

normalization_adapter.natural_units: fail closed pending explicit unit conversion

stf5_chart.caution: not orthonormal; use induced Gram metric or a declared orthonormal transform for SVD/covariance
